Version 1.1.0 — Major update: Enhanced AI-driven Polymarket paper trading with improved strategies, guardrails, and usability.

- Introduces PredictScope cloud-hosted trading with real order books, real prices, and zero-risk paper money.
- Adds two-tier control: customizable market selection strategies and strict order strategy safety rules.
- Supports flexible strategy filters—by category, wallet following, liquidity, and more.
- Enforces configurable, explicit trading guardrails (slippage, position sizing, diversification, etc.).
- Streamlines setup with simple API key configuration and workspace management.
- Detailed guidance for session workflows and AI trading behavior, encouraging autonomous, thesis-driven trading.
